WHAT CHANGES IS AN INPUT, NOT A MECHANISM: ZERO ScenarioConfig fields move versus the superseded keeper 2026-09-13-nyiso-232-st-gas, no flag is armed, no offer-curve band multiplier is touched, and this DOF ledger is carried over BYTE-IDENTICAL because the recipe is byte-identical (the arm is that keeper's recipe replayed via scripts/replay_keeper.py). BASIS IS RULE 14 [R-ACCURATE], NEVER THE RESIDUAL: the superseded input was WRONG on ordinary trading days (a hyphen-only header pattern dropped the spaced form, landing every price in such a week on the FOLLOWING trading day - committed 2023-01-06 read 3.17 where EIA published 3.50) as well as incomplete through Winter Storm Elliott (EIA published Transco Z6 NY at 32.12 on 2022-12-22 and 35.61 on 2022-12-23; the model burned 8.05, its own annual median, flat for eleven days). RULE 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE] VERIFIED on the shared basis file: of 940 rows, 30 moved and EVERY ONE IS NYISO. The two run_config fields that differ from the superseded keeper are both PROPAGATION, NOT CHOICE: committed_band_measured_basis None->False is a new default-off field materializing at its default (same posture, frozen cache-key drop value "False"), and gas_offer_margin_anchor_by_zone is DERIVED AT SOLVE TIME - meta.json carries only the boolean gas_offer_margin_zonal_anchor: true, and the anchor delta equals the signed annual-mean change in delivered gas to 1e-15. G-DRIFT was re-run at this session's head (37 changed solve-path files vs the keeper's git_sha, all classified INERT for NYISO; moved_rows("NYISO")=0 and the keeper's recorded solve_surface fingerprint bd2b4657f9b5df7e reproduces byte-identically), so rule 29(b) form 4 held and NO control solve was spent. REPORTED AT FULL MAGNITUDE AND GATING NOTHING: no C3a or C3b band verdict flips in either direction - 2022 still FAILs C3a at -10.51% (was -11.60%), 2023/2024/2025 still PASS (-1.76 / -0.13 / -9.19%). The PRECOMMIT pre-registered that C3a might get WORSE and that this would not justify reverting; the symmetric discipline was applied, and the improvement was NOT treated as promotion evidence - the OWNER promoted on the structural case. OPEN AND SURFACED, NOT ACTED ON: gas_offer_margin_anchor_by_zone is anchored to the ANNUAL MEAN delivered gas, so a 61-day winter repair shifts prices in all twelve months (Jan-Oct signed mean +0.21762 $/MWh vs anchor delta +0.213359, ratio 1.020), and the annual C3a movement tracks the SIGN of the annual-mean gas change in 4 of 4 years - i.e. a LEVEL effect, not the tail hours the repair was about. Pre-existing, merely made visible here, and deliberately not compensated for.
governance.note: authorized_price_tuning is NONE. This run DOES move two offer-curve band multipliers -- ST_GAS.econ_low and ST_GAS.econ_high, both to 1.0 -- and check (2) states that movement in full rather than denying it. It is not the rules 1/13 carve-out because the carve-out governs a band IDENTIFIED BY THE PRICE RESIDUAL, and this band is identified by the rule-24/25 neutral prescription, introduces zero new literals, and moves price DOWN in all four years against residuals already negative in two of them.

band_movement_stated_in_full.why_this_is_not_the_rules_1_13_carve_out: The carve-out governs a band multiplier IDENTIFIED BY THE PRICE RESIDUAL (rule 20 [R-DOF] cross-reference R-AY). This band is identified by the rule-24/25 neutral prescription, introduces zero new literals, and moves the mean LMP DOWN in every one of the four years (-1.42 / -0.60 / -0.68 / -1.36 $/MWh), against residuals that are already negative in 2022 and 2025 -- so it cannot be a price fit even in principle, and it was pre-registered as an expected C3a-2022 FAILURE before the solve. The governing precedent is nyiso-199's owner ruling of 2026-09-06 on the structurally identical CT_PEAKER band substitution, recorded in scenarios.py: 'a band multiplier is otherwise the rule 1 carve-out channel; the values remain MEASURED, so rule 20 adds no ledger entry (R-AY applies to a band identified by the PRICE RESIDUAL, which this is not).' This run's own owner ruling is 'Arm it' (2026-09-13), on PRECOMMIT-nyiso232-st-gas-deleak.md Addendum A.
